design_status: exploratory thresholds informed by a disclosed read-only preflight

template_rules.core_chunks: for width k, aligned chunks pool[j:j+k] at j=0,k,...,W-k; widths may share cores
template_rules.split_factors: positive divisors of the pre-tiling extent whose product divides the parsed pool width
template_rules.paired_state: ordered core group and local split tuple are one atomic template
template_rules.baseline: the parsed single core-pool option and single tiling option must themselves satisfy the paired template invariant and occur in the generated domain

signature_proxy.definition: ordered non-unit selected split dimensions that index the shared tensor operand, expressed in the pre-tiling workload unique-dimension namespace
signature_proxy.compatibility: a tuple is proxy-compatible iff it contains at most one distinct non-empty signature; empty signatures are wildcards
signature_proxy.count_formula: T=product_i(N_i); E=product_i(e_i); C=E+sum_s(product_i(e_i+m_i(s))-E), over the union of non-empty signatures
signature_proxy.noncartesian_definition: C is smaller than the product of the unary support projections of the compatibility relation
signature_proxy.validation_boundary: the abstract empty-or-equal rule passed Gate 1A-v4 micro production validation; equivalence of this pre-tiling projector on real transformed workloads remains unproved
